conventions.replaces: This file replaces the SH-15 contracts, which were moved to artifacts/architect/.prev-SH-15/api-contracts.json.
conventions.basePath: /api. This is the existing SchoolHub convention, not /api/v1. Route files are src/app/api/**/route.ts. (FR-41, NFR-6)
conventions.handlerPipeline: withHandler → requireRole → parseQuery with schemas from src/lib/validators/{dashboards,reports}.ts → one service call in src/server/dashboards/ or src/server/reports/ → ok(data) / paginated(rows, meta) / CSV Response. Everything comes from src/server/http.ts. Do not hand-roll envelopes. Scope is enforced inside services via getAccessibleStudentIds, not in the route. (NFR-3, NFR-6)

envelopes.list: { data: T[], meta: { page, pageSize, total } } via paginated(). ?page (default 1), ?pageSize (default 20, clamped to 100 by parsePagination). (NFR-6)
envelopes.csv: ?format=csv returns text/csv; charset=utf-8 with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<name>-<yyyy-MM-dd>.csv". The body is toCsv(columns, rows) from src/server/csv.ts, which applies escapeCsvCell (formula-injection guard). CSV ignores pagination and returns every row matching the filters. (FR-30, FR-33, FR-35)

errorPolicy: GET /api/students/:id/insights uses assertCanViewStudent. ADMIN/TEACHER callers denied get 403 FORBIDDEN, matching the existing helper. A nonexistent student returns 404 NOT_FOUND. (FR-43, NFR-3)
Unknown reportKey → 404 NOT_FOUND (registry lookup, not a Zod 400). (FR-44)
Invalid filters (bad enum, from > to, pageSize > 100 is clamped not rejected) → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. (NFR-6)
Filters are intersected with the caller's scope. A teacher filtering by a section outside scope gets an empty list (200), never 403 and never out-of-scope rows. (FR-42)
conventions.dates: Date-only fields are 'yyyy-MM-dd' strings. Instants are ISO 8601 UTC. Every 'today' / window rule is evaluated in SchoolSettings.timezone via the helpers in src/lib/dates.ts. (NFR-7)
conventions.caching: Cached payloads carry computedAt (ISO string) so the UI can show 'Updated N min ago'. Uncached fields have no computedAt. Payloads contain no Date or Decimal objects. (FR-23, FR-24)
conventions.audit: Only POST /api/dashboard/refresh calls audit({ action: 'dashboard.refresh', request }). GET endpoints are not audited, matching the existing admin read endpoints. (FR-24)

Trend.note: up = level rose since previousLevel. (FR-28, FR-29)

ChartSeries.summary: string — aria-label text, e.g. 'Attendance trend: 94.2 % average, lowest 88.1 % on 3 Oct' (NFR-2)
ChartSeries.series: { id: string, label: string, data: (number | null)[], stack?: string }[]

ReportResult.title: string
ReportResult.filters: object — the parsed filters echoed back
ReportResult.rows: object[] — same rows the CSV contains (FR-35 AC 7)
ReportResult.notes: string[] — e.g. 'Announcement read rate is not available yet' for engagement (FR-38)

endpoints.description: TEACHER only. Returns all teacher widget data in one payload; the page itself renders widgets from the same service functions, so this route is for API consumers and tests. Scoped to the caller's courses and accessible students. Announcements are an empty array with available=false (PRD-12 dependency gap).

data.todaysClasses: (ScheduleItem & { attendanceTaken: boolean, takeAttendanceHref: string, courseHref: string })[]
data.toGrade: Cached<{ count: number, items: { kind: 'SUBMISSION' | 'QUIZ_ATTEMPT', id: string, title: string, studentName: string, courseName: string, submittedAt: string, href: string }[] }>
data.upcomingDeadlines: Cached<{ kind: 'ASSIGNMENT' | 'QUIZ', id: string, title: string, courseName: string, dueAt: string, submitted: number, expected: number, submissionRate: number }[]>

endpoints.description: STUDENT only. Returns the caller's own widget data. Nothing is cached. dueSoon lists overdue (missing) items first with overdue=true.

data.dueSoon: { kind: 'ASSIGNMENT' | 'QUIZ', id: string, title: string, courseName: string, dueAt: string, overdue: boolean, href: string }[]
data.recentGrades: { gradeItemId: string, title: string, courseName: string, percent: number | null, gradedAt: string }[] (last 5)
data.courses: { courseId: string, courseName: string, percent: number | null, letter: string | null, progress: { completed: number, total: number }, nextLessonHref: string | null }[]

endpoints.description: ADMIN only. Returns admin widget data. kpis.openSafeguardingReports is present only when isSafeguardingLead(user) and is never cached; otherwise the key is omitted. quickActions is not returned (static links in the UI).

data.kpis: Cached<{ activeStudents: number, activeTeachers: number, attendanceRateToday: number | null, attendanceRateDelta: number | null, registersMissingToday: number, pendingAbsenceNotes: number }> & { openSafeguardingReports?: number }
data.gradeDistribution: Cached<ChartSeries & { average: number | null, median: number | null }> (10 % buckets)
data.riskSummary: Cached<{ byLevel: { HIGH: number, MEDIUM: number }, byReason: { ATTENDANCE: number, GRADES: number, MISSING: number } }>
data.upcomingEvents: { eventId: string, title: string, startsAt: string, endsAt: string | null, allDay: boolean }[] (next 5)
data.recentActivity: { id: string, action: string, actorName: string | null, entityType: string | null, entityId: string | null, createdAt: string }[] (last 10)

endpoints.description: ADMIN only. Forces recomputeRiskSnapshots({ force: true }), then revalidateTag('dashboard:admin'), ('dashboard:teacher') and ('insights:at-risk'), then audit('dashboard.refresh'). No body. The client shows a toast and calls router.refresh(). skipped='no-term' when there is no current term (snapshots unchanged, caches still revalidated).

ADMIN (all students) and TEACHER (getAccessibleStudentIds). Lists current-term StudentRiskSnapshot rows with level not null. Filters are intersected with scope and never widen it. Sort: HIGH before MEDIUM, then reasons count desc, then name. ?format=csv returns every filtered row as CSV with AT_RISK_COLUMNS (filename at-risk-<date>.csv).
ADMIN, or a TEACHER for whom assertCanViewStudent passes. Returns the current-term snapshot (or null when not yet computed) with signals, level, reasons and the capped history (newest first, max 10).

data.history: { level: RiskLevel | null, reasons: RiskReason[], computedAt: string }[]

endpoints.description: ADMIN only. Looks up REPORTS[reportKey]; unknown key → 404 NOT_FOUND. Query is parsed with REPORTS[key].filterSchema. Returns a ReportResult. ?format=csv returns toCsv(columns, rows) with filename <reportKey>-<date>.csv; the CSV rows equal the table rows. Per-report filters and rows are listed in reportFilters below.

enrollment.charts: students by grade × gender (stacked); new enrollments and archives by month

attendance.rows: { group, present, absent, late, excused, total, rate }
attendance.charts: daily trend; lowest 20 students returned in summary.lowestStudents

performance.rows: { group, students, averagePct, A, B, C, D, F }
performance.charts: average by group; section comparison for same grade × subject (summary.sectionComparison)

completion.rows: { group, expected, onTime, late, missing, onTimeRate, lateRate, missingRate }
completion.charts: stacked on-time / late / missing by group

engagement.summary: { parentsSignedIn7d, parentsSignedIn30d, totalParents }; notes contains the announcement read-rate omission

workload.charts: weekly periods and grading backlog per teacher

nonHttpContracts.name: recomputeRiskSnapshots
nonHttpContracts.signature: (opts?: { force?: boolean }) => Promise<{ skipped: 'no-term' | 'fresh' | null, studentsComputed: number }>
